research_notes: The eventual operating cap can be accompanied by a validity condition such as recent validation epoch and workload coverage, not just a naked number.
This makes the policy self-describing and easier to audit.
If validity conditions fail, fallback to a conservative prior cap or trigger revalidation.
Such metadata is low complexity compared with adaptive runtime control.
The current research is generating the evidence needed to populate it.
No cap value is yet valid for promotion.
